trend: Mild dehydration and mood and attention (Armstrong et al., Journal of Nutrition 2012)
why: Evergreen and useful. It links the 3 PM slump to something people can fix for free, which balances the product posts.
text:
In a controlled study, losing just over 1% of body water was enough to lower mood and make tasks feel harder in healthy young women.

Before blaming the 3 PM slump on sleep or lunch, try the cheap fix first: a full glass of water with lunch and one more mid-afternoon.
